arguments:
set -Eeuo pipefail
export GIT_PAGER=cat PAGER=cat GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1
tmp="$(mktemp -d /tmp/rea-plcodex-legacy.XXXXXX)"
trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT
git clone --quiet --depth 1 --branch main https://github.com/martaxi-boss/Project-leader-codex.git "$tmp/repo"
cd "$tmp/repo"
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = c7996a41c22d99f52f25d4c12e793bb3b3a8917d
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
for name,limit in [('codex/owner_coordinator_ingress.py',237),('CODEX_COORDINATION.md',75),('codex/tests/test_owner_coordinator_ingress.py',45),('README_CODEX.md',75)]:
 p=Path(name); print('FILE',name,'COUNT',len(p.read_text().splitlines()),flush=True)
 for i,line in enumerate(p.read_text().splitlines()[:limit],1):
  print(f'{i:03} '+line[:210],flush=True)
